registers.name: GICR_STATUSR
registers.description: Error Reporting Status Register。GIC Redistributor (GICR) 寄存器

fields.name: WROD
fields.description: Write to an RO location. 检测到违规时，软件必须向此寄存器写入 1 来复位。 [0b0=Normal operation. ; 0b1=A write to an RO location has been detected.]

fields.name: RWOD
fields.description: Read of a WO location. 检测到违规时，软件必须向此寄存器写入 1 来复位。 [0b0=Normal operation. ; 0b1=A read of a WO location has been detected.]

fields.name: WRD
fields.description: Write to a 保留 location. 检测到违规时，软件必须向此寄存器写入 1 来复位。 [0b0=Normal operation. ; 0b1=A write to a 保留 location has been detected.]

fields.name: RRD
fields.description: Read of a 保留 location. 检测到违规时，软件必须向此寄存器写入 1 来复位。 [0b0=Normal operation. ; 0b1=A read of a 保留 location has been detected.]
